content: Crafting Great Prompts
A Guide to Effective AI Communication

slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to apply the 3 Cs.

slides.title: The Power of Great Prompts
content: Weak prompt gets a weak answer.
Great prompt gets a great answer.
Best prompts include 3 key ingredients: Clarity, Context, Constraints.
slides.narration:
A weak prompt gets a weak answer.
But a great prompt gets a great answer.
The best prompts have three key ingredients.
These are Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Let's explore each one.
slides.image_prompt: Split screen showing a confused AI with a weak prompt and a confident AI with a great prompt. Three distinct icons representing Clarity, Context, Constraints.

slides.title: 1. Clarity: Be Specific!
content: The AI doesn't know what you're thinking.
Vague prompts lead to generic, unhelpful answers.
slides.narration:
Let's start with Clarity.
Clarity means being specific.
The AI cannot read your mind.
Vague prompts give generic answers.
So, be very clear.
slides.image_prompt: Person looking confused at AI, thought bubble with question marks. AI with a blank, generic response.

slides.title: Clarity: Weak Prompt Example
content: Weak Prompt: "Write about electric cars."
slides.narration:
Let's try a weak prompt.
Open your AI chatbot.
Type this: 'Write about electric cars.'
What do you expect?
Think about it.
Is it clear enough?
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording showing a chatbot interface. User types 'Write about electric cars' in the input box and submits it.
slides.video_prompt: Demonstrate typing 'Write about electric cars' into an AI chatbot and submitting.

slides.title: Clarity: Good Prompt Example
content: Good Prompt (Clear): "Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
Now, let's make it clear.
This prompt is much better.
It specifies the format: 'short blog post'.
It defines the topic: 'top 3 benefits of owning an electric car'.
And it defines the audience: 'someone living in a city'.
This is clear.
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording of a chatbot interface. User types the improved prompt. Arrows pointing to "short blog post", "top 3 benefits", "living in a city".
slides.video_prompt: Demonstrate typing the clear prompt into an AI chatbot and submitting. Highlight the clear elements as they are typed.

slides.title: 2. Context: Give it Background!
content: Context tells the AI why you're asking.
It also tells who the audience is.
This helps the AI adopt the right perspective.
slides.narration:
Next, let's add Context.
Context gives the AI background information.
It explains why you are asking.
It also clarifies the audience.
This helps the AI choose the right tone and style.
slides.image_prompt: A thought bubble over an AI with information flowing into it (e.g., 'why', 'who'). AI then looks focused and understanding.

slides.title: Context: Good Prompt (from previous)
content: Good Prompt: "Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
We used this good prompt before.
It has some clarity.
But it lacks full context.
Who is the blog post for?
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of the previous 'Good Prompt'. Highlight 'short blog post', 'top 3 benefits', 'living in a city'.

slides.title: Context: Better Prompt Example
content: Better Prompt (with Context): "Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
Let's add more context.
This prompt specifies the blog type.
It's for a 'lifestyle blog'.
This blog 'focuses on sustainable living'.
Now the AI knows the perspective.
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording of a chatbot interface. User types the better prompt. Highlight 'for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living'.
slides.video_prompt: Demonstrate typing the better prompt into an AI chatbot. Highlight the added context as it is typed.

slides.title: 3. Constraints: Set the Rules!
content: Constraints are boundaries that shape the output.
Tell the AI the length, format, and style you need.
slides.narration:
Finally, we add Constraints.
Constraints are rules for the AI.
They set boundaries for the output.
Tell the AI about length.
Specify the format.
And define the style you need.
slides.image_prompt: AI robot with a ruler, a clock, and a style guide. Icons for length, format, style.

slides.title: Constraints: Better Prompt (from previous)
content: Better Prompt: "Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
Here is our better prompt.
It has clarity and context.
But it still needs constraints.
What is 'short'?
What tone should it use?
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of the 'Better Prompt'. Highlight 'short blog post', 'lifestyle blog', 'sustainable living'.

slides.title: Constraints: Excellent Prompt Example
content: Excellent Prompt (with Constraints): "Write a short blog post, under 400 words, for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city. Use a friendly and enthusiastic tone and end with a question to encourage comments."
slides.narration:
This is an excellent prompt.
We added a word count: 'under 400 words'.
We specified the tone: 'friendly and enthusiastic'.
And we added a closing instruction: 'end with a question'.
These are strong constraints.
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording of a chatbot interface. User types the excellent prompt. Highlight 'under 400 words', 'friendly and enthusiastic tone', 'end with a question'.
slides.video_prompt: Demonstrate typing the excellent prompt into an AI chatbot. Highlight the added constraints as they are typed.

slides.title: Bonus Tip: Provide a Persona
content: Tell the AI who to be.
Prompt: "Act as an expert travel agent specializing in budget travel. Create a 5-day itinerary for a trip to Rome for a solo traveler who loves history and food."
slides.narration:
Here's a bonus tip: use a Persona.
Tell the AI who to act as.
For example, 'Act as an expert travel agent'.
This guides the AI's response style.
It makes the output more relevant.
slides.image_prompt: AI wearing different hats (e.g., chef hat, doctor coat, travel agent uniform). A prompt box showing the persona example.

slides.title: Bonus Tip: Giving Examples
content: Zero-Shot, One-Shot, and Few-Shot Prompting.
This is about whether you give the AI an example to follow.
slides.narration:
Another bonus tip is giving examples.
This is called Zero, One, or Few-Shot Prompting.
It means showing the AI a pattern.
Let's look at each one.
slides.image_prompt: Three distinct icons: a blank slate (zero-shot), one example (one-shot), a few examples (few-shot).

slides.title: Zero-Shot Prompting
content: You give zero examples.
Most prompts are like this.
You just ask for what you want.
(All our previous examples are zero-shot).
slides.narration:
Zero-Shot means no examples.
You just ask the AI directly.
Most of our prompts so far were zero-shot.
It's the most common way to prompt.
slides.image_prompt: A user directly typing a request into an AI chat, no previous examples visible.

slides.title: One-Shot Prompting
content: You give one example to show the AI the pattern.
This is great for specific formatting.

Prompt: "Summarize text into key points like this: Text: 'The sun is a star, and it's the center of our solar system.' Output: 'Primary celestial body: Sun'. Now, use this format for the following text: [insert long article here]"
slides.narration:
One-Shot prompting gives one example.
This shows the AI the format you want.
It's useful for specific output styles.
Look at this example on the screen.
The AI learns from one instance.
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording of a chat interface showing the one-shot prompt example. The example text and output are highlighted.
slides.video_prompt: Demonstrate typing the one-shot prompt example, showing the example and then the instruction for the AI to follow the format.

slides.title: Few-Shot Prompting
content: You give a few examples to teach the AI a more complex pattern.
slides.narration:
Few-Shot prompting uses several examples.
This helps the AI understand complex patterns.
It learns from multiple instances.
This makes the output even more precise.
slides.image_prompt: A chat interface showing multiple examples of input/output pairs, followed by a new request.

slides.title: Summary
content: In this tutorial, we learned:
The 3 Cs of prompting: Clarity, Context, Constraints.
How to use a Persona for better AI interaction.
The difference between Zero-Shot, One-Shot, and Few-Shot prompting.
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, we learned about great prompts.
We explored the 3 Cs: Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
We also learned to use a Persona.
And we saw Zero-Shot, One-Shot, and Few-Shot prompting.
These tips will help you get better AI results.
slides.image_prompt: A graphic summarizing the 3 Cs and the three types of prompting (Zero, One, Few-Shot).

slides.title: Assignment
content: Write an excellent prompt for an AI chatbot.
Task: Get a 3-day travel itinerary for a family of four.
Include Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Use a Persona.
slides.narration:
Here is an assignment for you.
Write an excellent prompt for an AI chatbot.
Your task is to get a 3-day travel itinerary.
It's for a family of four.
Include Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Also, use a Persona in your prompt.
Practice these skills.
